latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of md2pdf: convert Markdown files to PDF using Pandoc and LaTeX.
- Supports multiple LaTeX engines (XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX, PDFLaTeX) with automatic detection.
- Includes options for table of contents, custom CSS, and code highlighting styles.
- Provides built-in CJK font support, standard margins, and syntax highlights for code blocks.
- Reports missing dependencies and provides installation instructions if needed.
